name: Chicago Traffic Tracker - Historical Congestion Estimates by Segment - 2011-2018

columns.name: TIME
columns.description: Date and time corresponding to congestion estimate.

columns.name: SEGMENTID
columns.description: Unique ID for each segment. See http://bit.ly/Vz3rIh for the geographic location of each segment.

columns.name: BUS COUNT
columns.description: Number of buses providing a GPS feed used to estimate congestion.

columns.name: MESSAGE COUNT
columns.description: Number of GPS probes received(or used) for estimating the speed for that segment.

columns.name: SPEED
columns.description:
Real-time estimated speed in miles per hour. For congestion advisory and traffic
